scope: Local regression evidence for deployment recovery, accessibility equivalence and CI coverage; no production fault injection or system settings changes.

pageComparisons.cases: Sixteen comparisons each at normal, 24 px root font and 24 px body font settings.

faultControls: Page reload is unapplied or delayed; immutable prior generation and four representations must be observed after rollback.
Certificate rollback reload and complete-chain verification must succeed before recovery is reported.
A failed fingerprint restore still permits verified old-chain recovery when its pointer was safely restored; overall failure remains visible.
Failed TLS pointer restoration prevents reload.
Lock contention is a benign skip; other lock failures propagate.
Repeated termination during bounded cleanup does not abandon private verification captures.
verification.negativeControls: New fault fixtures fail against the corresponding earlier implementation. A hidden heading is absent from the real Chromium accessibility tree despite passing earlier visual/content/focus checks.
ciCoverage: All Python probe/deployment fixtures with dependencies installed.
Required Chromium browser guards; missing Playwright is fatal.
Complete runtime, certificate optimizer and gallery client Docker builds.

limits: Local fault fixtures exercise controlled command and filesystem failures; they do not prove recovery from every host failure.
Live activation and transfer measurements are recorded separately after deployment.
